2122506553047814275.en_summary: BREAKING: Google says “the era of autonomous attacks has arrived.” Hackers using AI to scan software updates, figure out which security flaw each patch fixes and build an attack before companies install the fix, without human involved, per Google Threat Intelligence Group. “Defending against machine-speed threats at human speed isn’t feasible.”
2122506553047814275.zh_summary: 突發：Google表示「自主攻擊時代已到來」。黑客現在使用AI掃描軟件更新，弄清每個補丁修復的安全漏洞，並在公司安裝修復前建立攻擊，無需人類參與，據Google威脅情報小組。「以人類速度防禦機器速度威脅不可行」。
